guide.starfold_worlds.title: Survival Guide
guide.starfold_worlds.disabled: The survival guide is disabled in this pack.
guide.starfold_worlds.cooldown: Wait 30 seconds of game time before requesting another guide.
guide.starfold_worlds.full: Free one inventory slot, then run /starfoldguide to get your survival guide.
guide.starfold_worlds.received: Survival Guide added to your inventory. Use /starfoldguide for a new copy.
guide.starfold_worlds.page.1:
Your first night

Find wood, food and wool. Build a lit shelter and sleep in a bed to set your spawn. Leave a spare pick and some food at home before exploring.
guide.starfold_worlds.page.2:
Find your way back

If Atlas is installed, open it with M by default and mark your shelter. You can walk across the edges of a planet's six faces. Watch for steep drops.
guide.starfold_worlds.page.3:
Open your quest book

In Escape Velocity, open your inventory and click the FTB Quests icon. In JEI, hover over an item and press R for its recipe or U for its uses.
guide.starfold_worlds.page.4:
Start with iron

Look for iron, copper, coal and andesite. If coal is scarce, smelt logs into charcoal. Hearth has no osmium. You'll bring it back on an off-world trip.
guide.starfold_worlds.page.5:
Build a workshop

Use the quest book to get your first Create machines running. You'll need a steady supply of parts and fuel to build and fly your first ship.
guide.starfold_worlds.page.6:
Get another copy

Free one inventory slot and run /starfoldguide. The guide follows your game language. Add en_us or zh_cn to the command for a fixed-language copy.
